subject.title: [Feature]: Per-session activity state (busy/idle + awaiting_user, awaiting_subagent) via gateway API + WS statechange

question: What canonical public Gateway activity and attention contract should OpenClaw expose for per-session busy, waiting, stale-run, and child-session state?
rationale: This changes public Gateway RPC/event semantics and session-state ownership; current code lacks the requested surface, while open implementation candidates are partial and differ on API scope.

options.title: Approve Canonical Activity Contract
options.body: Define the `sessions.activity.*` RPC/event schema, persistence boundary, stale-run handling, attention states, and child rollup before merging implementation work.

options.title: Land Narrow Status/UI Slices
options.body: Allow narrower blocked/stale or Control UI progress work to proceed while this broader activity contract remains open.

options.title: Defer Public Gateway Surface
options.body: Keep existing `hasActiveRun`, diagnostics, and UI-local signals until maintainers are ready to own a broader Gateway API contract.

recommendation.title: Approve Canonical Activity Contract
recommendation.body: Define the `sessions.activity.*` RPC/event schema, persistence boundary, stale-run handling, attention states, and child rollup before merging implementation work.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is the live issue assignee and has adjacent gateway/protocol history, making him the best available routing owner for the API direction call.
